svg.title: The tour: CFG-002 on a closed route through the warehouse plan, looping
svg.desc: Looping view of the whole warehouse plan. The 2.0 mobile manipulator reverses out of its dock, crawls out of the dock lane with field set FS-2c, takes the cross-aisle and aisle 2 at the navigation limit with FS-1c, stops for a person who crosses ahead, waits, warns for 2 s and resumes, picks a tote at the station with the arm, carries it round aisle 1 with field set FS-4 past a bystander, places it on a drop shelf and docks again with the field muted in the last metre. A panel beside the plan names the zone, speed, field set, pose, state and the speed-up factor at each moment and lights the situation chips as they are reached; a timeline below shows the zones, the field length as a step plot, the speed-up factor and a cursor.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The tour: CFG-002 drives a closed route through the warehouse plan; the field set switches at each zone boundary

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dock lane Z3 at the crawl limit with FS-2c, aisles Z2 at the navigation limit with FS-1c, the carry leg with FS-4; the crossing of IS-01 and the resume of IS-10 played on the way.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Scene time 410 s shown in 50 s: transit runs faster than real time (the factor is printed), the situation at 1×. A viewer that shows the SVG as a still shows the robot docked.

svg.text: Kinematic motion from WP-S-04 v0.2 planning values (CFG-002 braked at 1 m/s², unmeasured; t_r 0.17 s; K = 1.6 m/s; planned acceleration 0.5 m/s²). A tour shows where the field sets apply; it does not show that a measure works.
